subject.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history

question: Should sourceReplyRoute=current-source become the canonical internal invariant shared by outbound delivery, source-reply classification, and Control UI history projection?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but accepting a new cross-owner route fact that can influence session-history association and final-reply handling requires outbound and Gateway owner confirmation.

options.title: Accept the shared route invariant
options.body: Land after exact-head gates and owner review because route resolution stays at the outbound owner and all consumers remain success-gated and narrowly tested.

options.title: Require a broader typed contract first
options.body: Pause and replace the module-private marker with a formally shared delivery-result type if maintainers want a stronger permanent contract before adoption.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared route invariant
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head gates and owner review because route resolution stays at the outbound owner and all consumers remain success-gated and narrowly tested.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner most directly to the outbound message-action path that must authoritatively establish the route fact.
